thesis: Infleqtion is the first publicly traded neutral-atom quantum technology company, a pure-play on both quantum computing and quantum sensing. FY2025 revenue of $32.46M (+12.6% YoY) provides rare near-term commercial validation among quantum names, anchored by government and defense demand. Recent catalysts — three DOE 'Genesis Mission' awards, a planned fault-tolerant neutral-atom deployment in Illinois, a Craig-Hallum Buy initiation ($19 target), and a Trump executive order fast-tracking quantum — reinforce the thesis, but a ~23.25M-share resale prospectus creates a near-term dilution overhang and the stock trades near its 52-week low. NVIDIA partnership, DARPA/DoD contracts, and 235+ patents underpin a differentiated but still pre-profitable business.

drivers: Fault-tolerant neutral-atom deployment in Illinois delivers on roadmap and validates commercialization
DOE 'Genesis Mission' and DoD/DARPA awards scale government revenue toward $50M+ annually
Logical-qubit milestones (10+, 25+, 50+) drive a re-rating toward the 100 logical-qubit 2028 target
Strategic acquisition interest from big tech (NVIDIA, Google, Microsoft) at a premium

base_case.assumptions: Revenue scales toward $40-60M by 2027 with sensing stabilizing at $30M+; computing revenue begins scaling; path to EBITDA breakeven by 2028-2029; the ~23.25M-share resale overhang is absorbed; analyst coverage expands beyond the current 5 firms

risks: Resale prospectus (~23.25M shares) and further capital raises drive persistent dilution and overhang
Revenue growth stalls and quantum computing milestones slip amid a history of over-promising
Quantum winter compresses sector funding and valuations
Competing modalities (trapped ion, superconducting, photonic) reach commercial scale first

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — first read on post-catalyst momentum and guidance
DOE 'Genesis Mission' and DoD/DARPA contract awards

key_risks: Share overhang: an updated resale prospectus registered ~23.25M shares, pressuring the stock near its 52-week low
Pre-profitability with TTM net loss of ($56.07M) and a multi-year path to breakeven; further raises would be dilutive
Quantum computing commercialization timeline uncertain; sector history of over-promising
Revenue concentration in government/defense contracts subject to budget cycles
Competitive technology risk from trapped ion, superconducting, or photonic approaches
